title.narrative: LLF - Kano State Agro-Pastoral Development Project

description.narrative: The Kano State Agro-Pastoral Development Project (KSADP) aims to improve agro-pastoral production systems in Kano State by addressing low animal productivity and conflicts caused by transhumance. The project focuses on building sustainable, resilient systems that can withstand climate and market shocks, through investments in market institutions, infrastructure, and natural resource management. The development objective is to boost agricultural productivity and competitiveness by improving infrastructure, access to inputs, value addition, market access, extension services, and capacity building. Target beneficiaries include smallholder farmers involved in key value chains like fresh milk, beef, rice, maize, sorghum, cowpea, soybeans, groundnuts, cotton, and other key stakeholders.
